operations.why: The protocol 2168 StructureBlockUpdate serializer writes the unredacted and redacted structure names as two consecutive strings; the redacted name has no presence marker on the wire.

evidence.summary: The exact v2168 serializer writes both structure-name strings directly with no optional marker.

operations.why: EducationSettings carries Agent Capabilities as one optional boolean. Modeling an optional AgentCapabilities struct containing an optional boolean would emit two presence markers instead of the single marker used by protocol 2168.

evidence.summary: The inherited serializer writes one optional presence flag followed by the capability boolean.

operations.why: EditorNetwork's protocol 2168 payload is a NetworkLittleEndian NBT value after the route flag, not two length-prefixed raw variant strings.

evidence.summary: The v712 serializer writes the route flag and delegates the remaining payload to the inherited NBT serializer; v2168 does not replace it.
The inherited serializer encodes EditorNetwork payload with writeTag/readTag.

operations.why: Camera preset aim-assist Target Mode is an optional little-endian int32 on the protocol 2168 wire, despite the documentation's uint8 label.

evidence.summary: The inherited camera-preset serializer reads and writes TargetMode with readIntLE/writeIntLE inside an optional slot.
